e2oQualifierTargetsByEvent.rule: per-event narrowing of e2oQualifiers: identity-binding events must bind an exact Subject (a sha), never a Repository

closingReceipt.rule: a receipt.persist closes iteration w only if it binds >=1 consequence produced by an actuation causally downstream of w and inside the receipt's own iteration segment; a consequence may be bound by at most one receipt

o2oHumanTaint.rule: a consumed object with an O2O path over any o2oQualifiers link to a Human (or origin=human) object is a human cause; paths do not enter humanPreEpochAllowedOutputTypes (legacy consumer-side rule; since court r8 failClosedProvenance.P2 additionally taints over the whole O2O component with no type exemption)

humanTouch.rule: every object a human.intervene event links under any qualifier (other than episode and originAuthority) is human-touched; the touch is a human cause for a later consumer unless the human act is in the consumer's own episode, strictly before that episode's epoch, and the object is of a humanPreEpochAllowedOutputTypes type (epoch is always the CONSUMER's); a later event consuming a human-touched object has a human causal in-edge, and O2O paths reaching it are human paths; taint propagates transitively through pre-epoch machine events to every object they output, so a pre-epoch hop cannot launder a human-authored next action
humanTouch.crossEpisodeCausality: a causal E2O flow (input/cause consuming an object produced in another episode) is REFUSED CROSS_EPISODE_CAUSALITY (R_missing_authority, AUTHORITY_FAILURE): no single epoch can judge it
humanTouch.r8: failClosedProvenance.P2 judges every human.intervene link except episode (originAuthority included) with no exemption list; exemptQualifiers now scopes only the legacy touch rule

freshReobserve.rule: a transition receipt[n] -> reobserve[n+1] -> workorder[n+1] counts only if reobserve[n+1] consumes receipt[n]'s output strictly after it, no other receipt.persist of the episode lies between receipt[n] and workorder[n+1], workorder[n+1]'s iteration segment reaches no observe/reobserve older than receipt[n], no event of that segment after receipt[n] reads (input/cause/subject) a Subject superseded at its position, and every object consumed (input/cause) anywhere in the causal cone of workorder[n+1] back to receipt[n] -- including the reobserve's own inputs and every machine hop -- is receipt[n]'s output, produced strictly after receipt[n], or part of the pre-declared envelope (an Objective/Authority that the episode's episode.start consumes under input/cause/originAuthority; an Objective/Authority is exempt by this provenance, never by its type), every event of that cone after receipt[n] is itself causally downstream of receipt[n] (a rooted cone: no decision taken from envelope state alone; the only unrooted hop allowed is an envelope derivation whose every causal input is envelope state and every output an Objective/Authority), the envelope objects cited (input/cause/originAuthority) in the cone are the same for every candidate transition of the episode (invariant: an envelope object consumed by some transitions but not all is per-iteration decision state), and since court r8 (failClosedProvenance.P3) the envelope is the frozen (P1) and unindexed part of what episode.start consumes -- a family of same-typed envelope objects (same type and Authority kind) or an envelope object whose attribute holds more than one value is indexed per iteration and not exempt -- every cone hop after reobserve[n+1] descends from reobserve[n+1], every causal hop is strictly increasing in time, and one reobserve[n+1] roots exactly one workorder[n+1] (a forked next action is not one transition; this replaces the r7 count bound, defeated by candidate inflation); otherwise the transition is not counted (ALD drops), the episode lists STALE_REOBSERVE (R_not_fed_back, SUBJECT_FAILURE) and an episode with any stale transition is not AUTONOMOUS

postEpochAuthorityChannel.rule: a human.intervene that outputs, modifies or links (any qualifier but episode, or any number of O2O hops in either direction from any object it links, i.e. its whole O2O component) an Objective or Authority opens a human next-action channel through that object; every later non-human event citing it (originAuthority, input, cause) whose epoch precedes the human act (or of another episode) has a human causal edge. An Authority output by a machine event after t0 is the same channel unless that event consumes the pre-declared envelope (an Authority granted at its episode.start), in which case it inherits the envelope's channel

authorizedActuation.rule: every actuation must have a workorder.issue of its own episode among its causal ancestors; an actuation with none is an unleased DO (R_missing_authority) and fails the episode

unattributedCause.rule: a post-epoch input with no producer in the log, consumed in a workorder's decision segment by anything other than observe/reobserve, makes that workorder not self-generated; since court r8 this is one instance of failClosedProvenance.P1, which covers every post-epoch link including observations

failClosedProvenance.P1: closed world (UNATTRIBUTED_EXOGENOUS_CAUSE, mu_on_O): every object a post-epoch machine event links under any qualifier except its own output (and an actuation's consequence) is either (i) output by a machine event of the same episode that is after t0 and strictly earlier in time, or (ii) frozen envelope state: linked by the episode's episode.start under any qualifier, with no producer after episode.start, no attribute value timed after t0, no post-epoch output and no post-epoch or foreign-episode human link, and (since r9, P3 over the whole episode) neither indexed nor varying; an OCEL ObjectChange on a non-envelope object is attributed only when timed exactly at the object's post-epoch machine producer, any other attribute value has no producing event and is unattributed (r9, K9); anything else (no producer, producer in another episode, an undeclared pre-epoch output, timestamp-only or equal-timestamp ordering) makes the affected workorders not self-generated and the episode FAILED; Human objects and objects a human act outputs after t0 or in another episode are P2's
failClosedProvenance.P2: human taint is qualifier-agnostic (HUMAN_CAUSALITY_AFTER_EPOCH, R_not_fed_back): a post-epoch event is human-caused if any object it links under any qualifier but episode, or any object in that object's O2O component (either direction, every o2oQualifier, any depth, no type exemption), is a Human or origin=human, is linked under any qualifier by a human.intervene after the consumer's t0 (or of another episode) no later than the consumer, or carries an attribute value timed after t0 exactly at a human act, or (r9, K8) an attribute value no event attributes timed at or after any post-epoch or foreign human act; the episode is ASSISTED; no exemption list, only the consumer episode's frozen pre-epoch envelope is lawful human origin
failClosedProvenance.P3: rooted, functional, unindexed cone (STALE_REOBSERVE, R_not_fed_back): see freshReobserve; hops of the cone of workorder[n+1] between receipt[n] and reobserve[n+1] descend from receipt[n], every other hop descends from reobserve[n+1]; every causal hop and reobserve[n+1] itself are strictly later in time than what they consume; the cited envelope is invariant across transitions; one reobserve[n+1] roots exactly one workorder[n+1]; an envelope family (same type and Authority kind) or an envelope object with a multi-valued attribute is indexed and not exempt; replaces the r7 count bound. Since r9 the indexed and invariant clauses hold over the WHOLE episode, not the work-order cone: indexed is judged over every object episode.start declares (any type, any qualifier), including an attribute key outside envelopeAttributes for its type (a key-indexed script); varying means an envelope object cited (any qualifier but episode) by some post-epoch machine events of one activity and not by all that cite envelope state; indexed or varying envelope objects lose the P1 exemption, so citing them anywhere after t0 (actuate, execution.start, provider.select, commit, gap.detect, any qualifier incl. evidence) is UNATTRIBUTED_EXOGENOUS_CAUSE

envelopeAttributes.rule: closed vocabulary of attribute keys an envelope object may carry, by type; any other key makes the object indexed (P3, fail-closed); types absent here admit no attribute on an envelope object

failClosedProvenance.evidenceCeiling: a script in one scalar attribute value of a single-valued envelope object is not visible to an OCEL court (residual, UNKNOWN)
